session_summary: Menu bar visual redesign — native colored metrics + live animated tray icon + disk accuracy fix

tasks_completed.task: Native colored tray text via objc crate
tasks_completed.details: Each metric is a separate NSStatusItem with colored NSAttributedString. CPU=blue, RAM=green, DSK=orange, GPU=purple. Uses Objective-C runtime directly — Tauri set_title() only supports monochrome.

tasks_completed.task: Live animated bar chart tray icon
tasks_completed.details: 4 hot pink (#FF2D55) bars rendered as 44x44 RGBA bitmap, updated every tick with real CPU/RAM/DSK/GPU values. Not a template image — preserves color.

Iterated through 10+ icon approaches: app logo, pulse wave, heart, alien head (from AI stock vector), Unicode symbols, emoji dots, pixel art. All rejected at 22pt tray size — too mushy, too thin, or unreadable. Final: solid-fill animated bar chart.
Menu bar label changed from MEM to RAM for clarity.

tasks_completed.task: DSK accuracy fix — boot volume only
tasks_completed.details: Disk metric was aggregating ALL mounted volumes (external drives, Thunderbolt, Time Machine, disk images). Fixed to only read the root mount point ('/') — the actual boot drive.

dependencies_added.objc: 0.2 — Objective-C runtime bindings for native NSStatusItem colored text

architecture_decisions.decision: Separate NSStatusItems per metric instead of single combined tray title
architecture_decisions.reason: Tauri set_title() only supports plain monochrome text. Native NSStatusItem with NSAttributedString allows per-metric coloring.

architecture_decisions.decision: Live RGBA bitmap for bar chart icon instead of static PNG
architecture_decisions.reason: Static icons don't convey real-time data. Dynamic rendering via tauri::image::Image::new_owned() updates every tick.

architecture_decisions.decision: Hot pink (#FF2D55) for bar chart, NOT template image
architecture_decisions.reason: Template images force macOS monochrome tinting. Disabling template mode preserves the intended color.

architecture_decisions.decision: Boot volume only for DSK metric
architecture_decisions.reason: Aggregating all mounted volumes produced misleading disk percentages when external drives or disk images were mounted.

bugs_fixed.bug: DSK% inaccurate with external drives mounted
Bar chart had 3 bars instead of 4
bugs_fixed.fix: Added GPU as 4th bar, reduced bar_w from 8→6 and gap from 4→3 to fit

bugs_fixed.bug: Template image forced bar chart to monochrome

cpu.notes: Proper warmup sleep before first read

dsk.notes: Was aggregating all volumes — now boot drive only

gpu.method: ioreg IOAccelerator — max of Device/Renderer/Tiler utilization

network.notes: Not displayed in menu bar tray. Rate calculation is approximate — bytes since last refresh / 1024. Acceptable for dashboard display.
